description: A Stress and Anger Management session was conducted at KES SSC English Medium School on 13 October 2026 for 115 students from Grades 7 to 10. Dr. Rajul Patel (IAP) led the session, explaining common situations and circumstances that trigger stress and anger among young people. Through role plays and interactive discussions, students learned about the harmful effects of these emotions on their personality, mental, physical and emotional health, as well as their academic performance. Practical techniques to manage and regulate stress and anger were also introduced to help students respond more constructively to challenging situations.
location: KES SSC English Medium School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
